doc:
### PROPOSAL-02 — Voxel Art - **slug**: `voxel-art` - **Vibe**: Blocky, isometric-minded 3D pixel world: every pixel is a cube face and the dark canvas glows with neon at the edges. - **Best for**: Automation cockpit and Playwright run logs — robotic pipelines read like a game console. Adjectives: blocky, precise, game-console. - **Palette** (dark theme, `is_dark: true`): | Token | Value | Usage | |---|---|---| | `--bg-canvas` | `#05060f` | Deep space-navy black; app canvas | | `--bg-surface` | `#0c0f22` | Cube-face panel fill | | `--bg-surface-elevated` | `#161a38` | Raised cube faces, popovers | | `--border-subtle` | `#232a52` | Pixel-grid hairlines | | `--border-default` | `#2f3766` | Standard cube-edge borders | | `--border-focus` | `#7df9ff` | Electric-cyan focus outline | | `--text-primary` | `#f4f7ff` | High-contrast text on dark faces | | `--text-secondary` | `#b9c2e8` | Body text | | `--text-muted` | `#6b739c` | Helper text, coordinates, IDs | | `--color-action` | `#41f0ff` | Neon-cyan primary action | | `--color-action-hover` | `#2cd6e6` | Action hover (deeper cyan) | | `--color-earnings` | `#4ef36b` | Neon-emerald earnings | | `--color-earnings-hover` | `#37d456` | Earnings hover (deeper green) | | `--color-automation` | `#b86bff` | Voxel-purple automation accents | | `--color-alert` | `#ffcc00` | Warnings, pending states | | `--color-danger` | `#ff4d6d` | Failed states, deletes | | `--color-action-glow` | `rgba(65, 240, 255, 0.22)` | Neon aura behind action icons | | `--color-earnings-glow` | `rgba(78, 243, 107, 0.22)` | Neon aura behind earnings icons | | `--color-automation-glow` | `rgba(184, 107, 255, 0.22)` | Neon aura behind automation icons | - **Typography**: Display: `"Chakra Petch", "Space Grotesk", sans-serif` at 600-700 with slightly wide tracking (0.02em). Sans: `"Space Grotesk", system-ui, sans-serif`. Mono: `"IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, monospace` — all timestamps, IDs, and log lines are mono. KPIs always `tabular-nums`. - **Radii & Borders**: Hard squares everywhere — `border-radius: 0`. The only exceptions: 2px on tiny chips and 4px on inputs. 1-2px borders; focus is a 2px `--border-focus` outline, never a ring. - **Component Patterns**: - **Buttons**: Square corners, 2px border, hard 4px offset block shadow (0 blur, like a cube lip). Primary = neon fill with near-black text; hover = the offset flips to the top-left. Secondary = dark fill + neon border. Focus = 2px cyan outline with 2px gap. - **Cards**: Square panels with a "cube lip" bottom-right corner (pseudo-element draws a 2px lighter top face + darker side face, implying isometric depth). Hover raises the lip by 2px. - **Badges/Status**: Square chips with a pixel-corner notch (one corner cut). Status dot is a 2x2px square block, not a circle. Publishing = blinking square block. - **Tables**: Rigid 1px grid with full column rules; header cells tinted as "top cube faces" (lighter); row hover = 2px left neon edge. All numbers monospace. - **Forms/Inputs**: Flat square fields, 2px borders, focus = 2px neon outline. Helper text is a small mono caption below. - **Loading**: A pixel cube that "steps" through rotation on discrete frames, or three square blocks stacking one at a time. - **Signature detail**: The cube-lip corner and square status blocks — everything resolves to axis-aligned cubes, even the cursor. - **Motion & Animation**: Chunk-snappy, 60-90ms, `linear` or stepped easing; elements snap onto the grid rather than fading. Turbo Stream rows insert with a 2px "block drop" (translateY 4px to 0). No springs, no bounces. - **Signature Preview Snippet**: ```html
09:42:11 [PUBLISHED] tiktok-8821.mp4 -> live
```
